name: ADMET ML Benchmark
description: Evaluates machine learning performance for ADMET property prediction while comparing the practical impact of different molecular feature representations.
general_score_metric: ROC-AUC for classification endpoints; RMSE or R2 for regression endpoints
typical_sota_score: variable by property; often ~0.70–0.95 AUC for easier endpoints, lower on noisy/rare properties
reputation: Widely used within cheminformatics and drug-discovery ML research for comparing molecular representations, but not a single community-wide standard.
notes: Heterogeneous tasks with small and imbalanced sets for many endpoints, experimental/label noise, scaffold/chemical series leakage risk, non-LLM benchmark focused on molecular representations.
